protocol.test_status: Previously observed dates; exploratory comparison, NOT fresh untouched holdout.
protocol.label_policy: Mask each unavailable label independently; every training label ends strictly before split. No labels used for input normalization.
protocol.target_scale_policy: Fixed 0.01*sqrt(h); equal mean absolute scaled error across the five heads. No future-fitted scale.
protocol.selection: Choose among5 candidates per index/horizon using equal-fold mean ORIGINAL return MAE over3 development windows; freeze all40 choices and per-candidate median6 validation epochs BEFORE held-out fitting/scoring. Also report all candidates, zero, matched historical mean, validation-selected transforms and validation-selected raw-or-transform.
protocol.pooling: One shared five-output network across8 indices, with an index-ID embedding. Daily prices aggregated into nonoverlapping five-session OHLCV blocks; first block may be shorter.
protocol.origins: All lookbacks share origins with complete maximum1260+1-session history for each index. Training minibatches take every5th observed exchange origin; validation reports and test use daily origins.

architecture_spec.tcn: 8 channels,8 causal kernel3 residual blocks with dilations1..128,receptive field511 blocks,dropout0.1
architecture_spec.patchtst: 8-block patches (about40 sessions),8-dimensional embedding,2 heads,1 encoder layer,FF16,dropout0.1; channel-independent encoder and learned channel mixing
architecture_spec.linear: Shared temporal projection per channel, learned channel mixing; DLinear7-block moving average; NLinear removes last block without price-level addition to return head

limitations: Previously observed test dates: exploratory only
Two seeds, fixed small CPU budget; no exhaustive hyperparameter search
Historical index backfill and correlated overlapping labels remain
These are adapted architecture implementations, not exact upstream benchmark reproductions
protocol.target_transform_policy: u=return/(0.01*sqrt(h)); raw=u; asinh=asinh(alpha*u)/alpha; signed_exp=sign(u)*expm1(alpha*abs(u))/alpha. All slopes at zero equal1; no clipping, post-hoc scaling or future-fitted parameters.
protocol.early_stop_policy: Original-return scaled MAE only; invert outputs before scoring. Average original-return predictions across the two seeds.
protocol.lookback_policy: Hold756-session TCN input fixed at previous validation-selected length; require1260+1 complete sessions for same eligible origins as previous neural experiment. No new architecture or lookback search.
